meta.purpose: classifier trained on the real captures under representation A (raw), the pre-registered rule's headline representation; not the shipped default
meta.training_data: REAL: data/real, sets _02, _03 (sessions per class: fast 2, shuffle 2, walk 2), 60 s per session, one subject, figure-8 path, tethered USB; stances by detector.find_stances + merge_close on raw counts at the committed thresholds
meta.representation_decision: Shipped default is B (conductance), frozen at stage 20 on the _02 set and left standing at stage 21. On the two-session data the pre-registered rule prefers A (raw) by 2 stance(s) in 224, a margin finer than this data can resolve, so the freeze was not disturbed. This is a recorded decision, not a constraint of the file format: infer_live.py loads whichever representation a model names.
meta.split: leave-one-session-out, 2 folds, pooled over the folds

heldout_check.split: leave-one-session-out, every stance tested once out of its own session, pooled
heldout_check.wilson95_caveat: The pooled interval treats 224 stances from 2 capture sessions of 1 subject as 224 independent observations. Stances within a session are positively correlated, so the true interval is WIDER by an unknown amount; two sessions cannot estimate the between-session variance. Use the per-fold intervals as the honest spread.
